notes.title: Beta Branch Update v1.2 (8/17/208)
notes.notes:
Hello Thieves,

I know it has been a long time since the last update.  We have not stopped development but are getting close to our final release.  This update has two huge features that took most our time since the last update and since they are so big, may come with more bugs that need work.  Since there is only so much 2-3 people can test we have decided to open the update in a separate BETA branch to help with testing.  After a short time in the BETA branch we will push the update to the live public branch.

The first of this is the conversion from running off your computer's FPS to delta time.  This in itself brings a lot of bug fixes with menus and different monitor's frequencies but also improves performance on lower end pc's.  Please report all bugs that have anything to do with timing or frame count in order to help out.

The second big update is ONLINE CO-OP.  We honestly had not planned on this but with the many comments that this game needed it we decided to incorporate it into Mini-Thief.  Again, this is early stages and we have been testing for over a month but there is only so much a small staff can do so we are looking to the player-base to report any bugs so we can fix them before the push to the public branch.  Online Co-op is only available for the Story Mode, so you will not be able to play Custom, Workshop maps or go to the pawn shop with anyone else.

[h1]Join BETA branch[/h1]
-Right Click on Mini Thief in Game Library
-Click Properties
-Click Beta tab
-In drop-down box click "beta" branch
-Game should update or Queue for update

[h1]Online Co-op[/h1]
-To opt-out of online co-op go to Settings and set "Online" to OFF.
[u]Host[/u]
-Play a game like normal single player game.
-You automatically are open to new incoming players starting at (but not limited to) the "Player Select" screen.
-You receive all rewards and punishments from finishing a level
-Be wary of Griefers
[u]Client[/u]
-Select "Play Game"
-Select "Join Game"
-You will automatically search for a game
-Joins host wherever they are in the progress of the level
-Once you finish you will be brought back to a waiting screen but you are still connected to the same Host.
-You receive all rewards but no punishment for being the client.

[h1]Version 1.2[/h1]
-Converted all speeds to run off fps to delta time (also SHOULD fix menu issues)
-Many performance improvements
-Changed Pause Menu to actually pause game
-Changed Level Progression:
     *you now unlock next level regardless of difficulty completed
     *unlock up to same difficulty level as level completed
-Online co-op implemented - Story mode only
-Added Text chat for online play

notes.title: Update v1.13 (10/8/2017)
notes.notes:
Hello Thieves,

I know a lot of time has gone by since our last update but its been a wild Summer.  Firstly, a special thanks to everyone that provided feedback.  There has been some gameplay updates but most of the time spent has been on the House Editor and the newly added Workshop support.

The reason for the length of time was that we did not want to release an update with already known bugs and shoddy Workshop support, so we finally got the game to a state that is ready for the public.

Unfortunately, due to Game Maker's limited file system control, full workshop support is only available to Windows users.  We will continue working towards support for our Linux users and will try getting a hotfix out as soon as we can.

Workshop has been implemented so that no prior knowledge is necessary to contribute.  It is extremely easy to upload and update a house on your workshop so all you need to do is come up with crazy houses!  Stranga and I have uploaded a few houses to the workshop in order to test various features, so whereas you may download them.... Don't expect much because they are ONLY for testing and will probably be deleted soon.

[h1]v1.13[/h1]
-New awareness system for Thief; NPCs behind walls are harder to see.
-Insurance now saves money.
-Cleaned up many, many, many issues in House Editor mode. Both editor and Play mode.
-Added Workshop support for House Editor; Windows only (working on file system issues with linux)
-Added Workshop option to "Play Game" menu
-Updated Alert graphic to be more noticeable
-Now possible to lose NPCs with decoys and hiding
-Fixed Main menu text box bugs
-Fixed bug that prevented NPCs from catching player while trying to escape
-Improvements to Custom Level menu
-Fixed hiding bug
-New Inventory system

[h1]Upload to Workshop[/h1]
-Build a house (duh)
-SAVE the house!
-Open Editor menu and select "Publish"
-if it is a new workshop item select "Publish"
-if you would like to update an existing item select "Update"
-Once the progress stats disappear, you are done
-New items being uploaded generally take about 5-10 minutes to display on Workshop
-Updated items are almost instant
-Update the House's Workshop page with details and more photos if you'd like

[h1]Subscribe/Play Workshop Items[/h1]
-Search Mini Thief's Workshop Page
-Click Subscribe
-When download is done start Mini Thief
-Go to "Play Game"
-Select "Workshop"
-A list of all your Workshop items should display so just pick the house

Whereas we have tested Workshop, there still may be bugs so if you come across any please report them to the Bug Reports sub-forum.

Thanks and Enjoy!

notes.title: Update Alpha 1.09 (12/24/2016)
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays, Thieves!

'Tis the season for thievery.  We bring you an big update before the big day.  Check out the Changelog below for the details.  Also as discussed we will be switching online mode to Steamworks API Network which means no more IP entering.  Shouldn't be much longer as the connections and the gameplay are all synced up and just need to incorporate rules and structure back into the PvP mode; i.e. Lobbies, Role switching (owner/thief).

This biggest change in this update is the introduction to our House Creator.  Hate our levels?  Make your own, save it, then play it!  It is very much in its beginning stages so I wouldn't be surprised if there are bugs and crashes but it is very functional in its current state.  At the moment, we have not set up Workshop with the game but it is on our to-do list so we're hoping that won't take long either.

Though you can't share your houses through Workshop, all houses you create are saved locally into a single .ini file so you can always take it upon yourself to share until the Workshop is up and running.  All houses are saved to the game's local application data folders (i.e. Windows - %APPDATA%\Local\Mini_Thief\Custom Houses).

[h1]v1.09[/h1]
-Can now sneak past trip wires
-New cutscenes
-Added scrolling level select menu
-New Hat
-Fixed PvP controls bug
-Changed font
-New Level Added - Train
-Fixed menu control issue with controller
-Added House Creator

House creator is best used with mouse and keyboard.  Up/W and Down/S change asset categories (Walls, floors, searchables). Left/A and Right/D changes to a different model (wood walls, kitchen walls, etc..).  You must place a player spawner somewhere.  

Placing NPCs can be tricky at first (hopefully testing will determine better ways), there are two categories; Normal and Timed.  Normal spawns them immediately, Timed spawns them when the countdown is up.  In order to create a patrol path for an NPC, switch to the select tool, select the NPC, then click the path you want it to go.  press Delete to remove the path and Esc to deselect the NPC.

notes.title: Update Alpha 1.08 (9/13/2016)
notes.notes:
Hello Thieves!

Been a couple weeks since the last update but we've made a lot of changes.  Introducing new level, tools, and traps that should change gameplay drastically.  Also one of the biggest changes is randomized levels.  There are now some randomization to level;  NPCs MAY no longer follow a given path and security items locations have been mixed up and randomized so its very unlikely to have the same experience twice.

We have also added new hats/costumes that can be changed in the dressing room in the pawn shop as well as netcode optimizations.  

A large change we have done is to the safe you can buy in the pawn shop.  We have drastically lowered the price of the safe however is only a ONE TIME USE.  This is to make it act like an insurance system if you are unsure if you will succeed the next level, spend some money and buy some insurance.

All change you can view in the changelog.  Hope you enjoy!

[h1]Alpha 1.08[/h1]
-Added 2 New Level
-Added Night Vision Goggles to Shop
-New Hats added
-New Secret Hat added
-Added 2 secret costumes
-Fixed cutscenes skipping. Press a key to continue
-Added lighting to the Police station level
-Added more easter eggs 
-Fixed issue with Player getting stuck after searching an object
-Fixed placement of the unlocked text and lock icon above doors
-Aligned font letters better
-Cameras that find you have an exclamation mark above them
-Fixed security guards in bank running into the abyss
-Fixed level skipping bug
-Fixed using items while ingame pause menu is active 
-Disabled tool selection when ingame pause is active
-Disabled tool usage when player is hiding
-Change End level and title Animations
-Added option to visit Pawn Shop after each level
-Randomized patrols for Difficulties 2 and 3
-Increased Tool icon Hud spacing
-Fixed cutscene fade issue

notes.title: Update Alpha 1.08 (9/13/2016)
notes.notes:
Hello Thieves!

Been a couple weeks since the last update but we've made a lot of changes.  Introducing new level, tools, and traps that should change gameplay drastically.  Also one of the biggest changes is randomized levels.  There are now some randomization to level;  NPCs MAY no longer follow a given path and security items locations have been mixed up and randomized so its very unlikely to have the same experience twice.

We have also added new hats/costumes that can be changed in the dressing room in the pawn shop as well as netcode optimizations.  

A large change we have done is to the safe you can buy in the pawn shop.  We have drastically lowered the price of the safe however is only a ONE TIME USE.  This is to make it act like an insurance system if you are unsure if you will succeed the next level, spend some money and buy some insurance.

All change you can view in the changelog.  Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Update Alpha v1.07 (8/8/2016) **Online PvP testing begins**
notes.notes:
Hello Thieves!

Listed is the Changelog for the most recent update.  Sorry for the delay, but as you can see there were a lot of changes, most notably Online PvP is up and running **IN A TESTING STAGE**.  There are no rewards/punishments for online play at the moment, we are releasing this just to gather information to better assess how to balance the online game proper so all feedback (not on this thread, please make a thread in the Suggestions sub-forum) is greatly appreciated.

We are including the online portion of the game in the Demo during the testing phase for feedback purposes.  Tell your friends, test online, and let us know what you think!

Good Luck!

-Online PvP added **Very early testing**.  Mainly to gather information, bug test, and get feedback.  Open port 26900.
-Fixed co-op camera bug.

-Changed Looting so you can interact with only one instance at a time.
-Added Retro style effect, can be removed in Settings.
-Added Zoom effect, can be removed in Settings.
-Resolution adjustments.
-New Font Added.
-Changes to AI.
-Added Custom Controls for keyboard and controller.

notes.title: Early Access Release Information
notes.notes:
[h1]Early Access Release Info[/h1]

We apologize for the delay with the early access. Steam is having some technical difficulties at the moment which is preventing us from uploading the game. We will keep you posted when this problem is resolved and the release is up.

We all thank you for your patience. In the meantime, here are some patch notes that have been worked on recently.

[u]Rev. A1.03 (6/3/2016)[/u]

    *Minor bug fixes
    *How to Play removed from Main menu
    *New tools to use
    *Changed controls: Left and Right Arrow Keys select tool, Enter Key Uses tool
    *Gamepad controls updated: R&L Bumper/R1&L1 select tool, X Uses Tool
    *AI update: Creaking floors, falling vase, alarms, open doors, investigation
    *Hid Timer until 10 seconds left, also randomized Timer
    *Removed Dog barking while chewing on Chew Toy

[u]Rev. A1.04 (6/4/2016)[/u]

    *Controls menu added to the Options menu to reflect new controls
    *Dynamic music
    *Hotfix 1.04.1: AI bug fixes and minor adjustments

[u]Rev. A1.05 (6/6/2016)[/u]
    *Results screen updated to show counting money and items looted during raid.
    *Adjustments with stealth mechanics and detection.
    *Security Cameras now detect the player as well (rather than just speed up the timer).
    *Cardboard Box (MGS style) added to counter Security Cameras.
    *Tutorial Level created.
    *Security Guards now have flashlights.
    *Adjustment to random generated loot; Harder difficulty=more loot
    *New Sounds Added

Alpha 1.05 is the current release and if we add anything to it while waiting for the issues to be resolved I will update.
